headword: {食品保存|しょくひんほぞん}

definitions.explanation: The practice of treating and storing food to prevent spoilage and extend its shelf life. Includes methods such as refrigeration, freezing, drying, canning, and pickling.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ (food products) and ⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧ (preservation, storage). This is a practical term for daily life, cooking, and food safety discussions.

Japan has a rich tradition of food preservation, from ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧ (pickled vegetables) and ⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧ (dried fish) to modern vacuum-sealing and freeze-drying techniques. Proper food storage is frequently discussed on Japanese cooking shows and websites, particularly during Japan's hot, humid summers.
